requirement: Resolve the v1 bug tracker in dependency order, beginning with R1, and retain implementation evidence for every resolution item.

architecture.decision: Use DRUM_BY_PAD as the sole 12-pad mapping and schema v2 as the only persisted lesson format; migrate validated schema v1 lessons at the import/load boundary.
alternatives: Retain three coarse drum lanes and map pads only at playback.
Persist both a pad id and a redundant coarse drum sound.
tradeoffs: The canonical map requires broader type propagation, but preserves physical pad identity end-to-end.
Migration adds validation code, but keeps existing saved and imported v1 lessons usable while ensuring new writes are unambiguous.
seams: src/lesson.ts owns validation, migration, and v2 serialization.

tasks.title: Add the canonical 12-pad map and schema-v2 migration
tasks.intent: Ship the approved ROK assets and preserve exact physical pad identity in patterns and lessons, while safely accepting schema-v1 data.
constraints: Copy only the 12 locked ROK WAVs.
Do not mutate an editor pattern on invalid input.
tasks.acceptance: Every PadId has one canonical mapping; v2 lessons round-trip all 12 pads; v1 kick/snare/hat input migrates to 1/1.5/2; invalid lesson input is rejected.
verify: node self-check harness for pattern and lesson migration
tasks.visual: Browser smoke test of a selected pad triggering its mapped player where available.
tasks.result: Added the canonical pad model, copied the 12 locked runtime samples, and verified v2 round-trip, v1 migration, and invalid-data rejection.

tasks.title: Integrate twelve pads across playback, editing, and teaching
tasks.intent: Thread exact drum pad identity through all runtime flows.
constraints: Reuse DRUM_BY_PAD; retain three-class reduction only as canonical-pad input.
tasks.acceptance: Record, grid, cue, and hit feedback preserve exact PadId.
tasks.visual: 12 drum rows render in DRUMS projection.
tasks.result: Replaced the three-row editor adapter with 12 exact PadId rows and removed coarse runtime edit mapping.

tasks.title: Implement continuous live bass input
tasks.intent: Add pointer and keyboard attack, slide, and exhaustive release handling.
constraints: Tone.js and Pointer Events only; no gesture library.
tasks.acceptance: Mouse, touch/pen, and keyboard live bass sustain, slide, and always release.
tasks.visual: Pointer geometry remains correct under capture.
tasks.result: Implemented independent live and sequenced bass voices with coordinate-based pointer slides, keyboard parity, and exhaustive release paths.

tasks.title: Honor bass length in recording and sequenced playback
tasks.intent: Make held and slid notes record and loop legato across the loop seam.
tasks.acceptance: Held notes extend and slides join legato, including 31→0.
tasks.result: Bass holds and slides now update the existing length-aware note model; sequenced playback resolves sustained cells and remains legato through adjacent notes and the loop seam.

tasks.title: Replace the synthesized metronome click
tasks.intent: Use the approved Stick.wav through an attenuated dedicated bus.
constraints: Keep the Transport schedule unchanged; initial click bus −18 dB.
tasks.acceptance: Click is sampled, restrained, and downbeat accent is at most +3 dB.
tasks.result: Replaced the synthesized click with the locked Stick.wav asset on a dedicated −18 dB bus, retaining the Transport schedule and a +3 dB maximum downbeat accent.

tasks.title: Disable octave controls while in drums mode
tasks.intent: Prevent misleading octave interaction without resetting the selected octave.
constraints: Use native disabled controls and aria-disabled group state.
tasks.acceptance: Controls disable only in DRUMS and restore the previous bass octave.
tasks.result: DRUMS natively disables both octave buttons and marks the octave group unavailable; BASS restores the preserved octave and its normal range behavior.

tasks.title: Reshape the compact device panel
tasks.intent: Implement the explicit compact topology, exact physical pad-key geometry, compact transport, and retained orange theme.
constraints: Retain R3 coordinate-based sliding and 44px hit targets.
Do not expand half-step hit regions into the inner natural-key traversal lane.
Keep unshipped HIP, TEC, and BOX profiles disabled.
tasks.acceptance: Desktop chassis fits the locked control placement; inner bass traversal moves directly between natural keys while the outer path can select half-steps.
tasks.result: Rebuilt the pad with 7 full-depth natural keys and 5 outer half-depth half-steps under layered hit testing, and composed the instrument pane as one chassis with the locked control topology and a symbol-only transport.
tasks.uatRevision: 2026-07-14, user direction: the bordered chassis is retired and the device fills the pane height; BPM and tempo knob move to the top left; the nameplate and beat indicator move to the top right, anchored to the top edge; DRUMS/BASS becomes a horizontal pair; the octave axis and the profile grid share one height. The approximately-3:2 aspect clause is retired with the frame. The pad's 300px floor (the width at which a half-step key still clears 44px) now sets the desktop pane split at 46/54.

tasks.title: Project a stable 12-by-32 grid by instrument mode
tasks.intent: Show the stored drum or bass layer using mode alone, with a label rail that cannot offset or compress the aligned 32-step plane.
constraints: No second projection state; preserve horizontal scrolling at narrow widths.
Labels must not consume any of the 32 step tracks.
tasks.acceptance: Both modes show 12 labelled rows and distinct 32 columns; headers, cells, dividers, and playhead share exact column centerlines.
tasks.result: The grid now renders 12 rows projected by the instrument mode, with row labels in a fixed rail and one shared 32-column template used by the header, every row, the divider, and the playhead.
evidence: header-to-row column alignment delta 0.000px across all 32 columns
drum and bass layers verified intact across a DRUMS/BASS round trip
